summaryZh: UCSD Cognitive Development Lab研究婴幼儿与儿童的社会学习、亲子互动、语言和词汇学习，以及认知控制、灵活思维与抽象推理。研究主要采用行为方法，并与合作者结合EEG和建模，探究儿童如何理解交流线索、改变思考方式并形成概念。
researchQuestions: 婴儿如何学习预测他人的交流信号，并通过行为影响成人反应？
语言和符号线索如何帮助儿童灵活思考？
topics: 婴儿社会学习与亲子互动

evidence.quote: Welcome to the UCSD COGNITIVE DEVELOPMENT LAB
Cognitive Development Laboratory Principal Investigator: Gedeon Deák
Infant social learning, shared attention, and communication; parenting behaviors [ACTIVE]
We conduct research on questions related to: infant-parent interactions, and social learning in infancy;
language development including natural language input to infants, and word learning in young children cognitive skills in children, including executive functions
Our research primarily uses behavioral methods but with our collaborators we sometimes incorporate neuropsychological (EEG) and modeling techniques.
We study how cognitive flexibility and control change with age, and factors that help children ‘think flexibly.’
